name: Dominate (Dark Ages) — 1 Basic — Observance of the Spoken Word

system.description:
You can issue simple commands that demand obedience. You must focus your word into a single word, but that word can be embedded in an otherwise innocuous sentence if you so desire. The command word must be simple and easily understood, and if concealed within ordinary discussion, it must be stressed so the target player knows what is happening. You must best your target in a Mental Challenge. If you win, the target must carry out the command to the best of his ability. Commands such as "Flee," "Stop," "Silence" and "Follow" are typical. The command cannot blatantly result in the injury of the target. Commands that involve a continuing action last 10 minutes.

Unless otherwise noted, Dominate powers require eye contact and that the target can hear and understand the words of the vampire issuing the command. Cainites are immune to Dominate used upon them by vampires of higher generation.
